title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of Relevant Judicial Interpretations in Cases Involving the Collection and Disposal of Non-performing Assets by Huida Asset Trust Co., Ltd.
keywords_en: Case arising from the disposal of non-performing assets
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Application of Relevant Judicial Interpretation Provisions by People's Courts in Hearing Cases Arising from the Collection and Disposal of Non-Performing Assets by Huida Asset Trust Co., Ltd.

Fa [2006] No. 298

To: Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Huida Asset Trust Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Huida Asset Company"), established on August 1, 2005 with the approval of the China Banking Regulatory Commission, the Ministry of Finance, and the People's Bank of China, is a state-owned asset management company specialized in receiving, managing, and disposing of the historical non-performing assets of the People's Bank of China. Its predecessor was Everbright Asset Trust Co., Ltd., and it is now a subsidiary under the control of China Cinda Asset Management Co., Ltd. Pursuant to the approval document "Yin Jian Fu [2005] No. 148" of the China Banking Regulatory Commission, Huida Asset Company implements the relevant policies and systems applicable to existing state-owned asset management companies. In order to ensure the smooth progress of the asset disposal work of Huida Asset Company and reduce the cost of disposing of such non-performing assets, the following notice is hereby given regarding issues related to its civil litigation:

When hearing dispute cases arising from Huida Asset Company's collection and disposal of the historical non-performing assets of the People's Bank of China, the People's Courts shall similarly apply the provisions of the judicial interpretations, replies, and notices issued by the Supreme People's Court concerning the hearing of cases involving the disposal of state-owned non-performing loans by financial asset management companies.

October 30, 2006
